basis: Power, static thrust, RPM, propeller, controller, battery layout and motor mass are design-study assumptions, NOT a selected real product. Four additional 76 kg battery proxies are included in dry mass/inertia. Hull geometry comes from CAD; damping is an explicit engineering proxy evaluated with +/-25% sensitivity, not measured high-speed calibration.
limitations: Discrete propeller/hull surface sweep passed; no manufacturing fit or continuous minimum-clearance certification
No validated wave-making resistance, trim/planing or cavitation at target speed
Existing 4 kW generator cannot sustain 40 kW propulsion
Battery continuous-current, thermal, busbar, fuse, contactor and cooling design unverified
mass_layout_source: component_mass_ledger.json: individual batteries, trays and motor increment
